name: investigation
description: An investigation inside the person's mandate: a coverage checklist worked through, evidence kept with each lead in a ranked queue, the checklist's coverage checked, and the leads put to the person, who makes every decision.

work.title: Work the checklist
work.prompt:
Investigate, inside the mandate:

<question>
{{input.question}}
</question>

Write investigation/checklist.md, work through it, add the leads, and write investigation/report.md.

cover.title: Cover what is left
cover.prompt:
Items of investigation/checklist.md are not covered yet. Check each one (or mark it N/A with why), add any leads, and update investigation/report.md.

{{feedback}}

done-with-gaps.title: Ready, with checklist items not covered
